headline: Last session: Sensex surged 1,718 points as Nifty reclaimed 25,000 to cap best week in 6 years

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Sunday, 8 November.

why: Sensex soared over 1,700 points in the last trading session, driven by strong buying in auto and financial sectors.
Indian equities bucked a $5.7 trillion global tech rout and Wall Street selloff to post their best week in six years.
Bulls maintained control on Dalal Street, pushing the Nifty 50 to end Samvat 2082 above the 25,000 mark.
Early Diwali buying sentiment fueled a two-day massive rally across broad market indices.
whatHappening: In the last trading session, BSE Sensex jumped 1,718 points to close at 81,028, while NSE Nifty 50 ended at 25,030.
Noel Tata is stepping down as Chairman of Voltas and has been appointed Chairman Emeritus.
Global markets grappled with a $5.7 trillion selloff on Wall Street as artificial intelligence bets unwound.
Kwality Wall's reported a 44% rise in Q2FY27 revenue while posting a net loss of ₹17 crore.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices surged with the Sensex jumping 1,718 points to 81,028 and Nifty reclaiming 25,030. Indian equities bucked a global tech selloff to register their best weekly performance in six years. The stock market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Sunday, 8 November.
